title: Molded quickly, stained our tub.
text: Molded quickly, stained our tub.. While super comfy and definitely long, the mat didn't stay long in our home. Usually we're pretty good and keeping bath mats clean, but we weren't expecting this one to become dirty so quickly. As such, mold settled very quickly around the suctions. We then attempted to clean the mat, but it was too late. When we decided to discard the mat, we took a closer look at our tub and noticed blue and black stains that weren't there before we placed the mat.
